_comment: Curated per-repo knowledge the scan can't derive: public hosts, extra external SaaS a repo talks to, FE→BE notes, and cloud name maps. Data, not code — edit freely. Everything here is optional; an empty file is valid.
_hosts: Where a repo is actually reachable. `live` is its public URL, `api` the origin it calls. {env} is substituted per environment in the details panel.
_externals: Third-party services a repo uses that aren't visible as an npm dependency (a SaaS called over HTTP, an embedded widget). `curated` adds them; `exclude` removes a false positive the dependency scan produced.
_saasPatterns: Extra regexes that map a dependency or config string to a named SaaS, when the automatic name isn't recognisable.
_feToBe: Notes on how a frontend reaches its backends, for repos where the automatic grep is misleading. `method` records how the wiring was established.

edge-gateway.note: Node service, not a browser client — it proxies to the Java services rather than calling them as a frontend

_azureAppMap: Cloud resource name → repo, when a deployed resource isn't named after its repo. Also settable per-repo with the `azure-app-key` custom property.
_acrAlias: Container image name → the inventory component it belongs to, when the image isn't named after the component. Also settable per-repo with the `acr-image` custom property.
